string.text: %c[255,96,160,255]Fix New Game Loadout Tooltips%c[default]: Fixes new game loadout to use G.A.M.M.A. tooltips (and tooltip layout), shows outfit/helmet/weapon class icons on first open, sorts Loadout with non-weapon/outfit/helm items first (remaining gear keeps first-load size order), and keeps Inventory in cold-boot first-load order so quit-back matches the first open.
